summary: Minimal Substrait-aligned AST: 9 node types using frozen Pydantic BaseModel. ScalarFunctionNode handles 90% of operations via function key ENUMs. Other nodes: FieldReferenceNode, LiteralNode, CastNode, IfThenNode, SingularOrListNode, WindowFunctionNode, WindowSpec/WindowBound, and OverNode (extension).

key_classes.name: ScalarFunctionNode
key_classes.purpose: Universal node for most operations; carries function_key enum, arguments list, and options dict

key_classes.name: FieldReferenceNode
key_classes.purpose: Column reference by name; optional unknown_values set for ternary sentinels

key_classes.name: LiteralNode
key_classes.purpose: Constant value wrapper; dtype='native' for backend-native passthrough

extension_points: New node types for fundamentally new expression kinds
lifecycle_notes: Per minimal-ast principle: 9 node types is the target; new operations use ScalarFunctionNode with new function keys
to_substrait()/from_substrait() placeholder for future serialization (raises NotImplementedError)

evidence.detail: Pydantic BaseModel with frozen=True; all nodes immutable
